parent_channels.name: Constraint, Strain, and Release

subchannels.name: The Loaded Torso and Setting Down
subchannels.scene_or_process: A burden presses on the torso until it is lowered and the load-bearing frame is released.
subchannels.active_motifs: setting down a load `و ض ع:B001/m01`; heavy burden `و ز ر:B002/m01`; guilt borne as weight `و ز ر:B002/m02`; chest `ص د ر:B001/m01`; back `ظ ه ر:B002/m01`; creaking under weight `ن ق ض:B005/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The chest and back form one load-bearing body, the burden can be both material and culpable, and its removal reverses the creaking strain produced by sustained weight.

subchannels.name: Hardness Opening into Ease
subchannels.scene_or_process: A hard condition resists passage before becoming workable and easy.
subchannels.active_motifs: hardship and severity `ع س ر:B001/m01`; material or personal hardness `ذ ك ر:B002/m01`; opening and ease `ي س ر:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Difficulty behaves like hardness in a material or a person, while ease is the opening by which resistance gives way to readiness.

subchannels.name: Insolvency, Exaction, and Restored Means
subchannels.scene_or_process: Loss and creditor pressure narrow a debtor's means, while affluence and surplus reopen economic room.
subchannels.active_motifs: insolvency `ع س ر:B002/m01`; harsh demand on a debtor `ع س ر:B003/m01`; capital loss or discount `و ض ع:B004/m01`; confiscation `ص د ر:B005/m01`; affluence `ي س ر:B003/m01`; giving from surplus `ظ ه ر:B023/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Property can be diminished, exacted, or confiscated until the debtor is confined by scarcity; restored means and surplus reverse that confinement and enable unreciprocated giving.

subchannels.name: Obstruction and Usable Capacity
subchannels.scene_or_process: A tangled or resistant undertaking is met by sufficient power, preparation, and ease.
subchannels.active_motifs: obstruction and complication `ع س ر:B004/m01`; prevention `ء ل ي:B009/m01`; ability and capacity `ء ل ي:B011/m01`; precautionary reserve `ظ ه ر:B021/m01`; readiness and facilitation `ي س ر:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Resistance bends an undertaking away from completion, whereas reserve, capacity, and facilitation supply the means to straighten its course.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A constraining load produces bodily, material, or economic pressure until it is lowered, opened, or met by ease and capacity.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The same pressure-and-release pattern extends from a creaking back to insolvency, obstruction, and moral burden.

parent_channels.name: Attention, Effort, and Directed Desire

subchannels.name: Completion and Deliberate Re-engagement
subchannels.scene_or_process: Finishing one occupation clears attention for a newly chosen task pursued with effort rather than slackness.
subchannels.active_motifs: freedom after work `ف ر غ:B001/m01`; deliberate devotion to one matter `ف ر غ:B006/m01`; toil and exhaustion `ن ص ب:B004/m01`; exertion `ء ل ي:B010/m01`; absence of slackness `ء ل ي:B008/m01`; hurried work `م ع ع:B004/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Completion empties the field of prior work, deliberate focus fills it again, and the contrast between sustained exertion and haste defines how the new undertaking proceeds.

subchannels.name: Inclination, Aversion, and Appetite
subchannels.scene_or_process: Desire expands toward a wanted object, intensifies as appetite, or turns away in aversion.
subchannels.active_motifs: inclination toward an object `ر غ ب:B001/m01`; aversion from an object `ر غ ب:B001/m02`; expansive worldly desire `ش ر ح:B005/m01`; voracious appetite `ر غ ب:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: رغبة supplies a directional force that can approach or withdraw, while شرح renders its acquisitive form as an inner expansion and appetite renders it bodily.

subchannels.name: Aspiration toward a Governing End
subchannels.scene_or_process: A desiring subject turns toward an endpoint defined by lordship.
subchannels.active_motifs: endpoint and attained limit `ء ل ي:B001/m01`; divine lordship `ر ب ب:B001/m01`; desire directed toward `ر غ ب:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The endpoint is not an empty destination: it is the Lord toward whom رغبة is oriented, so direction, authority, and aspiration form one complete relation.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Available attention and strength are gathered around an undertaking, an object of desire, or a governing endpoint.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Emptiness after completion is not mere cessation; it becomes the cleared space for renewed effort and focused inclination.

parent_channels.name: Presence in Perception and Memory

subchannels.name: Appearance, Discovery, and Examination
subchannels.scene_or_process: An initially hidden matter becomes visible, is found, and is turned through its aspects for understanding.
subchannels.active_motifs: visible emergence `ظ ه ر:B001/m01`; discovery and finding `ظ ه ر:B008/m01`; examining a matter from every side `ظ ه ر:B018/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Appearance supplies the perceptible object, discovery brings the knower into contact with it, and examination turns that object until its several faces are understood.

subchannels.name: Recollection, Reminder, and Forgetting
subchannels.scene_or_process: A remembered matter is retained in the heart, renewed by a reminder, or lost by being cast behind the subject.
subchannels.active_motifs: recollection after absence `ذ ك ر:B003/m01`; reminder `ذ ك ر:B009/m01`; memorization by heart `ظ ه ر:B019/m01`; placing behind and forgetting `ظ ه ر:B012/m01`; preservation `ش ر ح:B006/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Memory keeps an object inwardly present, reminders restore that presence, and forgetting reverses the process by moving the object behind the field of attention.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: What is hidden or absent becomes present through appearance, discovery, recollection, or preservation.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The back-root links visible emergence and investigative discovery with the opposite act of placing something behind oneself and forgetting it.

parent_channels.name: Rank, Stewardship, and Power

subchannels.name: Public Elevation and Abasement
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person's standing rises through reputation and honor or falls through abasement and attached shame.
subchannels.active_motifs: elevation of rank `ر ف ع:B002/m01`; honorable repute `ذ ك ر:B007/m01`; lowered status or humility `و ض ع:B005/m01`; pride and boasting `ظ ه ر:B024/m01`; reproach falling away `ظ ه ر:B013/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Rank is treated as vertical position: reputation raises, abasement lowers, pride displays the raised state, and the removal of reproach releases the person from a contrary social weight.

subchannels.name: Authority and Burden-sharing Aides
subchannels.scene_or_process: A ruler, owner, or captain directs an ordered domain while ministers and helpers carry part of its burden.
subchannels.active_motifs: ownership and mastery `ر ب ب:B001/m02`; captain of sailors `ر ب ب:B017/m01`; minister who carries another's load `و ز ر:B004/m01`; supporting ally `ظ ه ر:B006/m01`; body of supporters `ظ ه ر:B016/m01`; presenting a person or case to authority `ر ف ع:B004/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Command is distributed through a hierarchy: the master or captain governs, a matter is advanced before authority, and aides make rule sustainable by bearing delegated weight.

subchannels.name: Ascendancy and Defeat
subchannels.scene_or_process: Sufficient power produces elevation over an opponent, while the defeated party is overcome.
subchannels.active_motifs: prevailing and rising over `ظ ه ر:B007/m01`; overcoming a person `و ز ر:B006/m01`; power and ability `ء ل ي:B011/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Capacity becomes positional superiority, and superiority culminates in mastery over the opposing person.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Vertical and load-bearing relations become social relations of elevation, rule, assistance, dominance, and defeat.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 94:4 رَفَعْنَا/ذِكْرَكَ, with indirect extensions from 94:2 وَضَعْنَا/وِزْرَكَ, 94:3 ظَهْرَكَ, and 94:8 رَبِّكَ.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Raising a name extends into presenting a case before authority, commanding a vessel, carrying a ruler's burden, and prevailing over an opponent.

parent_channels.name: Established Forms and Their Undoing

subchannels.name: Raising, Erecting, and Dismantling
subchannels.scene_or_process: Components are placed, raised into an upright form, and then loosened or dismantled.
subchannels.active_motifs: placement and establishment `و ض ع:B001/m02`; physical raising `ر ف ع:B001/m01`; erecting an upright object `ن ص ب:B001/m01`; unfastening rope, cloth, or building `ن ق ض:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Placement gives components a site, raising and erection give them organized form, and نقض reverses that organization by separating what had been made firm.

subchannels.name: Covenant, Record, and Entrusted Property
subchannels.scene_or_process: An obligation is sworn, recorded, negotiated, or entrusted and can then be breached or forcibly reclaimed.
subchannels.active_motifs: oath `ء ل ي:B007/m01`; covenant `ر ب ب:B011/m01`; deed of right `ذ ك ر:B008/m01`; negotiated agreement `و ض ع:B011/m01`; deposit placed in trust `و ض ع:B010/m01`; breach of oath or covenant `ن ق ض:B001/m02`; confiscation `ص د ر:B005/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Speech creates the obligation, a deed preserves it, agreement or deposit locates rights between parties, and breach or confiscation reverses that ordered possession.

subchannels.name: Repair, Fixed Base, and Reopening
subchannels.scene_or_process: A damaged or weak form is completed around a stable base but may split open again after apparent settlement.
subchannels.active_motifs: repair and completion `ر ب ب:B002/m01`; fixed base, handle, or origin `ن ص ب:B006/m01`; weakly consolidated form `و ض ع:B012/m01`; wound reopening after healing `ن ق ض:B004/m01`; settled matter becoming unstable again `ن ق ض:B004/m02`; firm knot `ر ب ب:B016/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Repair gathers a form around an anchoring base or knot, weak consolidation threatens that integrity, and renewed opening returns the form to instability.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Physical, social, and healed forms acquire stability through placement or binding and lose it through dismantling, breach, or reopening.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 94:2 وَضَعْنَا, 94:3 أَنقَضَ, 94:4 رَفَعْنَا, and 94:7 فَٱنصَبْ.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The undoing of a rope or building shares a precise structural pattern with breaching a covenant and reopening a healed wound.

parent_channels.name: Conflict, Defense, and Allegiance

subchannels.name: Armament, Hostility, and Battle Clamor
subchannels.scene_or_process: Armed opponents confront one another amid raised calls and the tumult of battle.
subchannels.active_motifs: war equipment `و ز ر:B003/m01`; confronting enmity `ن ص ب:B008/m01`; battle clamor `م ع ع:B001/m02`; raised voice `ر ف ع:B010/m01`; calls and cries `ن ق ض:B006/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Weapons supply the material apparatus, نصب fixes the hostile relation face to face, and raised cries turn the confrontation into an audible collective event.

subchannels.name: Refuge and Defensive Reserve
subchannels.scene_or_process: A threatened party withdraws to a defensible place and relies on stored means and preventative preparation.
subchannels.active_motifs: refuge or mountain stronghold `و ز ر:B001/m01`; household reserve `ظ ه ر:B014/m01`; precautionary provision `ظ ه ر:B021/m01`; prevention `ء ل ي:B009/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Refuge supplies protective space, while reserve goods and prior precaution turn that space into sustained security rather than momentary escape.

subchannels.name: Alliance, Desertion, and Opportunistic Conformity
subchannels.scene_or_process: Helpers combine around a party, then fracture when companions turn their backs or attach themselves only to the victor.
subchannels.active_motifs: supporting ally `ظ ه ر:B006/m01`; group of supporters `ظ ه ر:B016/m01`; ministerial assistance `و ز ر:B004/m01`; mutual back-turning `ظ ه ر:B022/m01`; alignment with whoever prevails `م ع ع:B005/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Aid creates a load-sharing alliance, whereas back-turning breaks reciprocal orientation and opportunistic conformity replaces loyalty with attachment to present power.

subchannels.name: Directed Strike and Downward Turn
subchannels.scene_or_process: A weapon or limb turns downward and drives a broad thrust toward the opponent's face.
subchannels.active_motifs: downward twist `ي س ر:B009/m01`; face-level thrust `ي س ر:B009/m02`; broad blow or thrust `ف ر غ:B003/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: The motifs combine direction, amplitude, and target into one compact combat movement: a downward turn that opens into a broad, face-directed strike.

subchannels.name: Unavenged Blood after Dispersion
subchannels.scene_or_process: Violent conflict disperses the parties and leaves shed blood without a claimant or answering vengeance.
subchannels.active_motifs: blood left unavenged `ف ر غ:B004/m01`; groups departing in scattered succession `ع س ر:B011/m01`; battle tumult `م ع ع:B001/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Clamor marks the violent event, dispersion removes the collective able to answer it, and the blood consequently passes without requital.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Confrontation organizes weapons, sound, refuge, allies, and bodily motion, while defeat or abandonment dissolves that organization.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 94:2 وِزْرَكَ, 94:3 أَنقَضَ/ظَهْرَكَ, 94:5-6 مَعَ/يُسْرًا, 94:7 فَٱنصَبْ, and 94:8 إِلَىٰ.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Battle is represented not only by weapons and hostility but by roaring sound, reserve supplies, turned backs, opportunistic companionship, and unanswered blood.

parent_channels.name: Reproductive and Domestic Life

subchannels.name: Sexual Opening, Conception, and Male Offspring
subchannels.scene_or_process: Sexual opening and intercourse lead to emitted seed and the sexed identity of offspring.
subchannels.active_motifs: intercourse `ش ر ح:B004/m01`; defloration `ش ر ح:B004/m02`; female sexual anatomy `ش ر ح:B004/m03`; semen `ف ر غ:B005/m01`; male sex or male offspring `ذ ك ر:B001/m01`; boyhood `ي س ر:B011/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The motifs form a reproductive sequence from sexual access and emission to the designation of a male child and his early life stage.

subchannels.name: Difficult Delivery and Recent Birth
subchannels.scene_or_process: Pregnancy reaches a difficult labor, the burden is delivered, and mother and newborn enter the immediate postpartum state.
subchannels.active_motifs: giving birth and laying down pregnancy `و ض ع:B002/m01`; difficult labor `ع س ر:B006/m01`; recent lambing or birth `ر ب ب:B009/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: وضع converts pregnancy from a carried state into delivery, عسر names the resistance of labor, and the recent-birth motif supplies its immediate outcome.

subchannels.name: Postpartum Milk and Foster Care
subchannels.scene_or_process: A newborn is kept under care while milk and offspring increase or milk is retained in the udder.
subchannels.active_motifs: fostered child `ر ب ب:B005/m01`; caregiver or foster guardian `ر ب ب:B005/m02`; milk and offspring abundance `ي س ر:B006/m01`; retained milk or colostrum `ر ف ع:B007/m01`; postpartum ewe kept near home for milk `ر ب ب:B009/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Guardianship supplies the social relation, the postpartum animal supplies the domestic setting, and abundant or retained milk supplies the material of continued nurture.

subchannels.name: Veiling and Marital Body Analogy
subchannels.scene_or_process: A woman's bodily visibility is regulated by removal of the veil and by a marital utterance that invokes the prohibited maternal back.
subchannels.active_motifs: removing a woman's veil `و ض ع:B009/m01`; marital ẓihār formula `ظ ه ر:B010/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: One motif changes bodily visibility through uncovering, while the other changes marital relation through a spoken analogy to the maternal back; both organize access to the female body.

subchannels.name: Shaped and Marked Bodily Surfaces
subchannels.scene_or_process: Bodily contour is augmented, protrudes, or bears visible lines and identifying marks.
subchannels.active_motifs: feminine body padding `ر ف ع:B008/m01`; buttock and adjoining flesh `ء ل ي:B015/m01`; protruding eye `ظ ه ر:B009/m01`; palm lines and thigh brand `ي س ر:B008/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Padding alters contour, the haunch supplies the shaped body region, and protrusion or inscribed lines make bodily form legible at the surface.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Embodied life moves through sexual union, conception, difficult delivery, postpartum nurture, and socially marked bodily presentation.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 94:2 وَضَعْنَا, with indirect extensions from 94:1 نَشْرَحْ, 94:3 ظَهْرَكَ, 94:4 ذِكْرَكَ/رَفَعْنَا, and 94:5-6 ٱلْعُسْرِ/يُسْرًا.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The birth scene extends into fosterage, milk retention, veiling, marital formulae, body shaping, and visible bodily marks.

parent_channels.name: Journeying and Mounted Motion

subchannels.name: Mounting, Carrying, and Travel Wear
subchannels.scene_or_process: A riding animal lowers itself for mounting, bears the rider or load, and may be exhausted by repeated journeys.
subchannels.active_motifs: pack or riding animal `ظ ه ر:B005/m01`; camel lowering its neck for the rider `و ض ع:B013/m01`; riding before training `ع س ر:B008/m01`; girding and riding `و ز ر:B007/m01`; travel-worn camel `ن ق ض:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Mounting begins with bodily accommodation, girding secures the rider, the animal's back becomes transport, and premature or repeated use explains resistance and exhaustion.

subchannels.name: Gait, Speed, and Compliance
subchannels.scene_or_process: Rider and animal move through degrees of acceleration, breadth of stride, lifted tail, and easy responsiveness.
subchannels.active_motifs: intensified gait `ر ف ع:B003/m01`; urging a mount to run `و ض ع:B003/m01`; spacious stride or path `ف ر غ:B003/m01`; light compliant movement `ي س ر:B005/m01`; raised or bent tail in running `ع س ر:B009/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The rider initiates acceleration, the animal answers with an extended and compliant gait, and the lifted tail becomes the visible sign of running effort.

subchannels.name: Departure, Route, Lodging, and Destination
subchannels.scene_or_process: Travelers leave a watering place, take the overland route, continue through the country, lodge, and approach an endpoint.
subchannels.active_motifs: departure from water or land `ص د ر:B003/m01`; egress from a matter or place `ص د ر:B003/m02`; traveling upward through country `ر ف ع:B011/m01`; daylong gentle travel `ن ص ب:B010/m01`; overland road and outskirts `ظ ه ر:B015/m01`; lodging and staying `ر ب ب:B007/m01`; endpoint `ء ل ي:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Departure opens the itinerary, road and sustained travel carry the group beyond settlement, lodging interrupts the course, and the endpoint gives the journey its terminal orientation.

subchannels.name: Noon Heat and the Ominous Day
subchannels.scene_or_process: A group travels through midday and severe heat under the shadow of a difficult or ill-omened day.
subchannels.active_motifs: severe heat `م ع ع:B002/m01`; travel through heat `م ع ع:B002/m02`; noon `ظ ه ر:B004/m01`; ill-omened day `ع س ر:B010/m01`; daylong travel `ن ص ب:B010/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Midday fixes the temporal setting, oppressive heat supplies the environmental resistance, and the ominous day colors the traveler's full-day passage.

subchannels.name: Raised Travel Chant
subchannels.scene_or_process: Mounted travelers coordinate movement through a song or chant projected in a raised voice.
subchannels.active_motifs: travel song or camel chant `ن ص ب:B009/m01`; raised voice `ر ف ع:B010/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The chant belongs to the moving riders, while رفع supplies the vocal elevation that lets its rhythm carry across the journey.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A traveler prepares a mount, enters motion, follows a route, endures its conditions, and reaches a halt or destination.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 94:1 صَدْرَكَ, 94:2 وَضَعْنَا, 94:3 أَنقَضَ/ظَهْرَكَ, 94:4 رَفَعْنَا, 94:5-6 ٱلْعُسْرِ/يُسْرًا/مَعَ, 94:7 فَٱنصَبْ, and 94:8 إِلَىٰ/رَبِّكَ.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Travel joins bodily accommodation, animal training, speed, route geography, noon heat, ominous time, and raised chant.

parent_channels.name: Cultivation, Care, and Living Yield

subchannels.name: Fosterage and Gradual Nurture
subchannels.scene_or_process: A guardian takes charge of a dependent and brings that person or thing toward completion stage by stage.
subchannels.active_motifs: gradual nurture and completion `ر ب ب:B002/m02`; fostered child `ر ب ب:B005/m01`; caregiver or custodian `ر ب ب:B005/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: The dependent is defined by being under care, the caregiver supplies continuing oversight, and رب names the gradual process by which incompleteness becomes maturity.

subchannels.name: Knowledge Cultivated and Preserved
subchannels.scene_or_process: A scholar cultivates knowledge and self, preserves what is learned, and keeps it available for recollection.
subchannels.active_motifs: learned or wise servant of the Lord `ر ب ب:B003/m01`; cultivating knowledge and self `ر ب ب:B003/m02`; preservation `ش ر ح:B006/m01`; retained recollection `ذ ك ر:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Learning is treated as husbandry of both knowledge and knower, with preservation and recollection carrying the cultivated result forward.

subchannels.name: Rain, Vegetation, Guarding, and Harvest
subchannels.scene_or_process: Layered cloud and abundant water sustain green growth, which emerges from the earth, is guarded, and is lifted after harvest.
subchannels.active_motifs: layered rain cloud `ر ب ب:B008/m01`; rain nurturing vegetation `ر ب ب:B008/m02`; abundant fresh water `ر ب ب:B013/m01`; evergreen plant `ر ب ب:B012/m01`; earth splitting for a truffle `ن ق ض:B003/m01`; earth's raised surface `ظ ه ر:B003/m01`; guarding crops or young palms `ش ر ح:B006/m02`; lifting harvest to the threshing floor `ر ف ع:B006/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Water and enduring cloud provide the growing condition, the earth opens to release produce, guarding preserves it, and lifting the cut crop completes the agricultural cycle.

subchannels.name: Herd Aggregation and Pasture
subchannels.scene_or_process: Animals gather as a herd, remain near water and forage, or move away in scattered succession.
subchannels.active_motifs: herd of wild cattle or camels `ر ب ب:B014/m01`; grazing and staying near water `و ض ع:B007/m01`; forage and grazing place `و ض ع:B007/m02`; scattered or successive animal groups `ع س ر:B011/m01`; abundant water `ر ب ب:B013/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Water and forage hold the animals in an aggregated pastoral scene, while scattered departure supplies the contrasting motion by which the herd loses cohesion.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Sustained tending gathers dependents, knowledge, land, and herds into conditions where they can mature or produce.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 94:1 نَشْرَحْ, 94:2 وَضَعْنَا, 94:3 أَنقَضَ/ظَهْرَكَ, 94:4 رَفَعْنَا/ذِكْرَكَ, 94:5-6 ٱلْعُسْرِ/يُسْرًا, and 94:8 رَبِّكَ.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The root of lordship extends through child-rearing and cultivated learning to rain-fed vegetation, guarded crops, harvest, herds, and pasture.

parent_channels.name: Provision, Containment, and Distribution

subchannels.name: Wide Vessels and Flowing Contents
subchannels.scene_or_process: A broad vessel or stone-edged basin receives plentiful liquid and releases it through pouring or an outlet.
subchannels.active_motifs: wide-bellied vessel or basin `ر غ ب:B002/m01`; pouring and emptying a vessel `ف ر غ:B002/m01`; vessel outlet `ف ر غ:B002/m02`; abundant water `ر ب ب:B013/m01`; stones forming a pool rim `ن ص ب:B003/m02`; thick syrup or oil residue `ر ب ب:B006/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Breadth provides capacity, the rim defines the container, abundant or thick contents fill it, and pouring converts stored provision into directed flow.

subchannels.name: Need, Appetite, and Generous Giving
subchannels.scene_or_process: Need or appetite meets a desirable gift drawn from abundance and surplus.
subchannels.active_motifs: need `ر ب ب:B016/m01`; voracious appetite `ر غ ب:B003/m01`; abundant desirable gift `ر غ ب:B004/m01`; favors `ء ل ي:B006/m01`; gift `ء ل ي:B012/m01`; bounty and benefaction `ر ب ب:B016/m03`; giving from surplus `ظ ه ر:B023/m01`; affluence `ي س ر:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Appetite and need define the recipient side of provision, while wealth, favor, and surplus define a giver able to supply an abundant and desired good.

subchannels.name: Portions, Fixed Shares, and Division
subchannels.scene_or_process: A whole is separated into named portions whose recipients or thresholds are fixed.
subchannels.active_motifs: portion of a whole `ص د ر:B006/m01`; assigned share `ن ص ب:B005/m01`; fixed quantitative threshold `ن ص ب:B006/m02`; division of a slaughtered camel by arrows `ي س ر:B007/m02`; collected allotment arrows `ر ب ب:B010/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: The whole becomes a set of portions, a fixed measure governs eligibility, and allotment arrows assign the resulting shares to participants.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Capacity receives material abundance, while need, appetite, gift, and assigned shares determine how contents circulate.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 94:1 صَدْرَكَ, 94:3 ظَهْرَكَ, 94:5-6 ٱلْعُسْرِ/يُسْرًا, 94:7 فَرَغْتَ/فَٱنصَبْ, and 94:8 إِلَىٰ/رَبِّكَ/فَٱرْغَب.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Spatial breadth becomes vessel capacity, then social generosity; the same field includes appetite, favors, surplus, fixed thresholds, and apportioned meat.

parent_channels.name: Ritualized Play and Sacrifice

subchannels.name: Gambling Arrows and Allotted Shares
subchannels.scene_or_process: Players draw or cast arrows kept in a dedicated container, and the outcome determines shares.
subchannels.active_motifs: gambling by arrows `ي س ر:B007/m01`; arrow container `ر ب ب:B010/m01`; collected allotment arrows `ر ب ب:B010/m02`; assigned share `ن ص ب:B005/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The container assembles the game pieces, the arrows generate the lot, and the result is converted into a participant's designated share.

subchannels.name: The Erected Target Game
subchannels.scene_or_process: An upright wooden marker is struck or uprooted by a thrown implement.
subchannels.active_motifs: throwing game with an erected post `ع س ر:B013/m01`; erected marker or boundary stone `ن ص ب:B003/m01`; broad blow or thrust `ف ر غ:B003/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: The post supplies a stable target, the thrown blow supplies the operation, and successful uprooting provides the game's visible outcome.

subchannels.name: Altar, Pouring, and Divided Flesh
subchannels.scene_or_process: A standing stone receives slaughter, poured blood, and cut flesh.
subchannels.active_motifs: standing stone for worship or slaughter `ن ص ب:B002/m01`; pouring out vessel contents `ف ر غ:B002/m01`; cutting and spreading flesh `ش ر ح:B002/m01`; division of the slaughtered animal `ي س ر:B007/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: The stone fixes the ritual site, slaughter supplies blood and flesh, pouring marks the surface, and cutting or division distributes the animal body.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Erected markers, stones, arrows, and divided bodies organize rule-bound acts of play, allotment, or sacrifice.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 94:1 نَشْرَحْ, 94:5-6 ٱلْعُسْرِ/يُسْرًا, 94:7 فَرَغْتَ/فَٱنصَبْ, and 94:8 رَبِّكَ.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The same upright apparatus can serve as a target, a lot mechanism, or a blooded ritual surface.

parent_channels.name: Language as Structured Relation

subchannels.name: Explanation and Naming
subchannels.scene_or_process: An obscure matter is opened into intelligible form and then made referable in speech.
subchannels.active_motifs: explanation and clarification `ش ر ح:B001/m01`; speaking, naming, or making known `ذ ك ر:B004/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: شرح discloses the structure of the matter, while ذكر gives that disclosed content a spoken or named presence.

subchannels.name: Reporting, Raised Voice, and Repetition
subchannels.scene_or_process: A message is projected publicly, voiced loudly, and may be repeated in speech or writing.
subchannels.active_motifs: broadcasting a report `ر ف ع:B005/m01`; raised voice `ر ف ع:B010/m01`; repeated use of “with” `م ع ع:B006/m01`; repeated written inscription `م ع ع:B006/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Reporting supplies the communicative act, vocal elevation supplies reach, and repetition stabilizes the expression across oral and written media.

subchannels.name: Relational Particles and Collective Reference
subchannels.scene_or_process: Function words locate an entity, qualify a proposition, or refer to a plurality.
subchannels.active_motifs: “to” used in the sense of “at” `ء ل ي:B002/m01`; particle rubba and its variants `ر ب ب:B015/m01`; collective relative expression `ء ل ي:B004/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The relational item locates, the particle modulates a proposition, and the collective expression binds plural referents into a single grammatical role.

subchannels.name: Derivation, Case, and Contradiction
subchannels.scene_or_process: A word is traced to its source, assigned grammatical position, or set against another statement.
subchannels.active_motifs: grammatical source or infinitive `ص د ر:B004/m01`; nominative case `ر ف ع:B012/m01`; accusative case `ن ص ب:B007/m01`; contradiction in speech or poetry `ن ق ض:B001/m03`
subchannels.synthesis: The source grounds derivation, رفع and نصب place the word within an inflectional structure, and contradiction performs a semantic undoing between utterances.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Speech makes meaning explicit through explanation, naming, repetition, relational particles, derivation, and inflection.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Physical raising, setting upright, originating, and undoing recur as technical operations of case, derivation, and contradiction.

parent_channels.name: Collective Arrangement and Place

subchannels.name: Accompaniment, Plurality, and Being Among
subchannels.scene_or_process: Separate persons or things are added together and occupy a shared collective field.
subchannels.active_motifs: accompaniment and addition `ء ل ي:B003/m01`; collective relative plurality `ء ل ي:B004/m01`; crowds or large groups `ر ب ب:B004/m01`; being among a people `ظ ه ر:B017/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Addition forms the group, plural reference names it as a unit, and being among its members supplies the participant's internal position.

subchannels.name: Settlement, Locality, and Boundary
subchannels.scene_or_process: A population is placed in a locality whose center, outskirts, and marked limits organize residence.
subchannels.active_motifs: settled transferred people or registered garrison `و ض ع:B006/m01`; tribe or named place `ع س ر:B012/m01`; named locality `ي س ر:B010/m01`; overland outskirts `ظ ه ر:B015/m01`; erected boundary marker `ن ص ب:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Placement establishes the population, names stabilize the locality, outskirts define its exterior, and markers make its limits materially visible.

subchannels.name: Dispersion, Egress, and Turned Backs
subchannels.scene_or_process: A collective leaves its shared position, scatters in succession, or fractures through mutual disengagement.
subchannels.active_motifs: scattered or successive groups `ع س ر:B011/m01`; egress from a place `ص د ر:B003/m02`; mutual back-turning `ظ ه ر:B022/m01`; opportunistic alignment with the prevailing party `م ع ع:B005/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Egress starts the separation, scattered succession dissolves compact form, and turned backs or shifting allegiance complete the social fracture.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Multiple units are joined, situated, bounded, or dispersed as social and spatial formations.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 94:1 صَدْرَكَ, 94:2 وَضَعْنَا, 94:3 ظَهْرَكَ, 94:5-6 مَعَ/ٱلْعُسْرِ/يُسْرًا, and 94:8 إِلَىٰ/رَبِّكَ.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Grammatical accompaniment becomes social aggregation, while settlement, outskirts, boundaries, and turned backs describe the formation and breakup of groups.

parent_channels.name: Material Cutting, Curing, and Layering

subchannels.name: Cutting and Curing Flesh or Hide
subchannels.scene_or_process: Animal material is cut into spread pieces or treated with plant and thick curing substances.
subchannels.active_motifs: cutting and spreading flesh `ش ر ح:B002/m01`; thin or dried meat slice `ش ر ح:B002/m02`; green tanning tree `ء ل ي:B005/m01`; thick curing syrup or residue `ر ب ب:B006/m02`; haunch flesh `ء ل ي:B015/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The animal body supplies flesh or hide, cutting opens and thins the material, and plant or concentrated substances preserve and transform it.

subchannels.name: Quilting, Armor Layering, and Unraveling
subchannels.scene_or_process: Cotton is placed and stitched into cloth, garments or armor are superposed, and the assembled fabric can be pulled apart.
subchannels.active_motifs: cotton padding and stitching `و ض ع:B008/m01`; superposed garments or armor `ظ ه ر:B020/m01`; unraveling rope or cloth `ن ق ض:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Placement and stitching build an insulated layer, superposition increases protective thickness, and unraveling reverses the assembly at its joins.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Raw organic or textile material is transformed by cutting, curing, padding, superposition, and possible unraveling.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 94:1 نَشْرَحْ, 94:2 وَضَعْنَا, 94:3 أَنقَضَ/ظَهْرَكَ, and 94:8 إِلَىٰ/رَبِّكَ.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: A tanning tree and thick curing substance join sliced flesh, quilted cotton, layered armor, and unravelled cloth in one material-work field.

parent_channels.name: S1. Left-side Orientation and Directional Turn
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A body or implement is distinguished by its left side and by a turn toward a lower direction.
parent_channels.active_motifs: left-handedness and the left side `ع س ر:B005/m01`; leftward side or movement `ي س ر:B004/m01`; downward twist `ي س ر:B009/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: The opposed hardship/ease roots converge lexically on the left side, while the downward twist converts laterality into directed bodily motion.

parent_channels.name: S2. Delay, Duration, and Brevity
parent_channels.scene_or_process: An interval can persist, be delayed, remain recent, or contract into brief duration.
parent_channels.active_motifs: lingering and detention `ء ل ي:B013/m01`; continued duration `ر ب ب:B007/m02`; recentness and youth `ر ب ب:B009/m02`; brief or small interval `ي س ر:B002/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: Duration supplies the temporal field, delay lengthens it, recentness locates an event near its beginning, and brevity contracts its extent.

parent_channels.name: S3. Aloeswood Fumigation
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Aromatic wood is consumed as incense to perfume a space through smoke.
parent_channels.synthesis: The lexical object carries its own complete use-scene: a material stick becomes fragrant smoke through fumigation.

parent_channels.name: S4. Cord for Lifting a Fetter
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A cord or thread raises a prisoner's restraint to permit controlled movement.
parent_channels.synthesis: The cord acts as a compact lifting mechanism between the restrained limb and the weight of the fetter.

parent_channels.name: S5. Feather Vane and Shaft
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A feather's rear shaft material forms a vane in a wing or fitted arrow.
parent_channels.active_motifs: rear feather or vane component `ظ ه ر:B011/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: The motif isolates a concrete object-part relation in which material taken from the feather's back becomes a functional flight surface.
